high_risk_moment: Before recruiter shortlist when eligibility or rank runs
harm_description: A hidden age or sex rule can auto-drop or bury a qualified person before any recruiter opens the file
existing_controls: I did not find a working appeal described in the public iTutorGroup write-up
proposed_controls: Turn off auto-reject. Check every eligibility rule against policy. Require a reason code.
human_oversight: A named recruiter must review before reject. Appeal reviewer can put the person back within two business days.
monitoring_metric: Auto-reject count and selection-rate ratio by age and sex
trigger_threshold: Any auto-reject or ratio below 0.80 for a monitored group with at least 30 people
response_action: Pause the tool keep logs tell compliance and re-review those applications by hand

high_risk_moment: Recruiter under time pressure trusts the ranked queue
harm_description: If the UI looks like a pass/fail score recruiters may never open lower-ranked complete files
existing_controls: Fallback to the old list is designed but not proven in our pilot yet
proposed_controls: Show evidence not a pass badge. Pull some lower-ranked complete files into the daily queue.
human_oversight: Recruiter lead samples files each week and can pause ranking.
monitoring_metric: Percent of ranked files opened before decision and override rate
trigger_threshold: Override rate under 5 percent for two weeks or sample miss rate over 10 percent
response_action: Switch to chronological list check the UI copy and retrain before ranking comes back

harm_description: Old hiring data can teach the ranker to push women down so they wait longer for an interview look
existing_controls: In the public story Amazon stopped the prototype rather than shipping it with gates
proposed_controls: Do not use protected fields or obvious proxies. Test subgroup recall before any model promotion.
human_oversight: Recruiter still sees evidence and must review a random sample plus near-threshold people.
monitoring_metric: Subgroup recall gap on a frozen test set
trigger_threshold: Gap above 5 percentage points on two test runs
response_action: Do not promote the model. Check features. Retrain. Ask for an independent re-check.
